content.comment_body: I need assistance. I receive 4-20 mA readings from a load cell every 2 minutes. I want to save the first reading and subtract it from the next reading after 2 minutes, repeating this process continuously. Is this achievable? How can the reading be stored and connected to a mathematical function block?
You can use a mathematical instruction block to store and process the analog value.
